title: Ibara
note: Shoot'em up by Cave (CV1000): credits, lives, lives_p2, bombs, bombs_p2 (MAME cheat database). Made by tools/cave_games.py.

retroarch.note: FinalBurn Neo core: CV1000 SH-3 RAM from 0xC000000, the first 3 MB of its 8, as far as the values of the game go, bytes swapped within 16-bit words

lives.note: lives (MAME cheat database, Infinite Lives PL1)

lives_p2.note: lives of player 2 (MAME cheat database, Infinite Lives PL2)

bombs.note: bombs (MAME cheat database, Infinite Bombs PL1)

bombs_p2.note: bombs of player 2 (MAME cheat database, Infinite Bombs PL2)

score.note: player 1 score, not in the cheat databases: learn it with learn.bat (score=...)

score_p2.note: player 2 score, learn it with learn.bat in a two-player game (score2=...)

activity.note: no BIOS says who plays: player 1 plays while these values move, as long as one of the moving ones is read (lives or bombs alone change too seldom)
